entities.name: Vladimír Boudník
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimír Boudník was a Czech graphic artist and photographer. He was a key figure in Czech post-war art and a representative of the "explosionism" movement. He is best known for his active and structural graphic art, but also created mostly photographic and monotype works that, until recently, remained unknown.
